courses.title: Deep Relaxation Workshop
courses.description: A one-hour Saturday morning workshop at the Thiruvananthapuram centre on systematic relaxation in the Sivananda style. It works through breath awareness, relaxing the body part by part and guided relaxation, as a way to let go of tension and rest the mind.
